1.

Praise be to Thee, O Jesus Christ, Who took my guilt upon Thee; Yea, all my judgment, my sin and lack, And bore the punishment for me! A sacrifice lamb, Thou wast led forth; Now there is no judgment for me.

2.

The bitter cup of judgment and death Was drained by Thee; Thy love, Jesus, moved Thee thereto, Now it is empty for me; A cup of rich blessing Is now held out to me.

3.

For me, O Jesus Christ, Thou didst die, And I have died with Thee; From the grave Thou didst take me with Thee, Now Thou livest in me, And soon in Thy glory I shall live with Thee.
